get_default_100k_cache: download and load a precomputed simulation cache for 100k default actions by tier
get_cache_folder: get the file system path to the offline simulation cache folder for a given action size
get_partial_cache_folder: get the file system path to the partial simulation cache folder for a given action size
SimulationCache_load_simulation_states: load and return an array of simulation statuses as integers for a given task ID
SimulationCache_get_sample: sample actions and simulation statuses from the cache for a specified set of tasks and action count
